title: Worksheet 14: Purchases and Real Money (V2.0)
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Many Roblox games and features can be purchased using real money, either directly through Robux or through special passes and items sold inside individual games. Because Roblox is often played on a phone, tablet, or computer that may already be linked to a parent's payment information, it is possible for purchases to be made quickly, sometimes without a parent immediately realizing how much money has been spent. Some games are specifically designed to encourage players to make purchases, using techniques like limited-time offers, flashy advertisements, or messages suggesting that a player needs an item to keep up with friends or compete fairly. Before making any purchase, it's important for kids to check with a parent or guardian first, since spending real money is a decision that affects the whole family's budget, not just the player. Many devices also allow a parent to set up purchase approval settings, requiring a password or permission before any purchase can be completed, which helps prevent accidental or unapproved spending.
